plugin-oidc-login.name: OpenID Connect
plugin-oidc-login.description: Use your identity provider to sign in to degoog administration.

setup.label: Before enabling
setup.description: Configure an issuer, canonical HTTPS degoog URL, client and explicit admin access rules, then select Use as settings gate. Register your public URL followed by /api/settings/auth/callback with the provider. Keep the existing password configured for console recovery.

useAsSettingsGate.label: Use as settings gate
useAsSettingsGate.description: Enable only after configuring the provider and explicit admin access rules. Replaces the normal settings password flow; unconfigured or failed OIDC logins remain locked.

issuer.label: Issuer URL
issuer.description: Exact issuer from your provider's discovery document. Supports issuer paths such as Authentik applications.

publicUrl.label: Public degoog URL
publicUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS URL, including a base path if used. Never inferred from proxy headers.

settingsPath.label: Settings path
settingsPath.description: Path relative to degoog, such as admin or your custom settings path. Existing settings-page return paths are preserved automatically.

clientSecret.label: Client secret
clientSecret.description: Stored server-side. Required for confidential clients.

clientAuthentication.label: Token endpoint authentication
clientAuthentication.description: Match the provider's client registration. Public clients (none) still use PKCE S256.

scopes.label: Scopes
scopes.description: Space-separated. Add groups if your provider requires that scope. Tokens are not retained or refreshed.

allowedSubjects.label: Allowed admin subjects
allowedSubjects.description: One exact sub claim per line. Subject IDs are bound to the configured issuer; stable IDs are preferred over email.

allowedEmails.label: Allowed admin emails
allowedEmails.description: One address per line. Requires email_verified to be boolean true. Matching is case-insensitive.

allowedGroups.label: Allowed admin groups
allowedGroups.description: One exact group per line. At least one access-rule field must be configured; an empty policy denies everyone.

groupsClaim.label: Groups claim
groupsClaim.description: Claim name or dotted path, such as realm_access.roles.

claimSource.label: Access-rule claim source
claimSource.description: Use UserInfo when the provider exposes email/groups there. Its subject must match the signed ID token.

accessRuleMatch.label: Combine access rules
accessRuleMatch.description: All requires every nonempty rule category to match. Any permits a match in one configured category.

automaticSearchLogin.label: Automatic sign-in from search
automaticSearchLogin.description: Silent makes one prompt=none round trip per tab when signed out. An existing IdP session can unlock search actions without visiting settings. Settings sign-in redirects interactively.

endpointOrigins.label: Additional provider endpoint origins
endpointOrigins.description: Optional HTTPS origins, one per line, only when discovery uses endpoints on a different host. The issuer origin is allowed automatically.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Provider request timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.description: 1000–30000 ms for discovery, token exchange, UserInfo and signing keys. Independent of search-engine timeouts.

sessions.label: Session behavior
sessions.description: Successful login uses degoog's native HttpOnly admin cookie. Current core sessions last 24 hours; IdP logout/group changes do not immediately revoke an existing degoog session. In-flight logins require a single process or sticky routing.
